Name: Galaxy cat retexture
Author: Zanarchium
Description:
My first mod!
Retextures the 3rd cat option to a galaxy one! Also, the first galaxy cat retexture on nexus mods for stardew valley!
 
How to use:
Step 1: Go on steam. Right-click on stardew valley. Click browse local files. go into the "content" folder.
Step 2: Extract the downloaded file.
Step 3: Go into the extracted file and drag "animals" into the "content" folder and click replace.
Step 4: Launch the game. use the cat with the purple collar. enjoy! Retextures the 3rd cat option to a galaxy one! Also my first mod!

Downloads.Description: Retextures the cat with the purple collar. works in 1.5
